|Script Content         |<details><summary>Click to expand...</summary>function Cleanup {<br>    cd $PSScriptRoot<br>    if (Test-Path $ScriptFolderPath) {<br>        Write-Host 'Removing script directory'<br>        Remove-Item -LiteralPath $ScriptFolderPath -Force -Recurse<br>    }<br>}<br><br>Function Setup {<br>    # Cleanup scheduled task if it exists<br>    $oldTask = Get-ScheduledTask -TaskName $ScheduledTaskName -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue<br>    if ($oldTask) {<br>        if ($oldTask.State -eq 'Running') {<br>            Stop-ScheduledTask -TaskName $ScheduledTaskName<br>        }<br>        Unregister-ScheduledTask -TaskName $ScheduledTaskName -Confirm:$false -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue<br>    }<br>    Cleanup<br>}<br><br>$LogPrefix = "\AutopatchClientV2SetupInstallScheduled"<br>$Timestamp = Get-Date<br>$LogPath = "$Env:windir\ccm\logs"<br>$LogFile = $LogPath + $LogPrefix + $Timestamp.ToFileTimeUtc() + ".log"<br>$ScheduledTaskName = 'Autopatch Client V2 Setup Installer'<br>$ScriptFolderPath = "$env:SystemDrive\ProgramData\Microsoft\AutopatchSetupScheduled"<br>$SystemScriptPath = "$ScriptFolderPath\SetupAutopatchClientV2Package.ps1"<br>$SystemScript = ''<br><br>if (-not (Test-Path $LogPath)) {<br>    New-Item -Force -ItemType directory -Path $LogPath<br>}<br>Start-Transcript -Path $LogFile<br><br>#Cleanup lingering resources from previous runs<br>Setup<br><br>$content = [System.Convert]::FromBase64String($SystemScript)<br><br>New-Item -ItemType Directory -Force -Path $ScriptFolderPath<br>Set-Content -Path $SystemScriptPath -Value $content -Encoding Byte<br><br>$Trigger = New-ScheduledTaskTrigger -Once -At ((Get-Date).AddHours(4)) -RepetitionInterval (New-TimeSpan -Hours 4) # Specify the trigger settings<br>$Settings = New-ScheduledTaskSettingsSet -AllowStartIfOnBatteries<br>$User = "NT AUTHORITY\SYSTEM"<br>$Argument = "-ExecutionPolicy Bypass $SystemScriptPath"<br>$Action = New-ScheduledTaskAction -Execute "PowerShell.exe" -Argument $argument # Specify what program to run andtask with its parameters<br>Register-ScheduledTask -TaskName $ScheduledTaskName -Trigger $Trigger -User $User -Action $Action -Settings $Settings -RunLevel Highest -Force<br><br>$MaxRetries = 10<br>Start-ScheduledTask -TaskName $ScheduledTaskName<br>$ScheduledTask = Get-ScheduledTask -TaskName $ScheduledTaskName -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue<br><br># Wait for the scheduled task to complete so its log can be read and uploaded<br>while (-not (($ScheduledTask.State -eq 'Ready') -or ($MaxRetries -eq 0))) {<br>    Write-Host "Waiting for scheduled task to complete"<br>    Start-Sleep -Seconds 60<br>    $MaxRetries--<br>    $ScheduledTask = Get-ScheduledTask -TaskName $ScheduledTaskName -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue<br>    if (-not $ScheduledTask) {<br>        # The scheduled task was removed by the install script because it installed clients successfully<br>        break<br>    }<br>}<br><br>if (-not $ScheduledTask) {<br>    # The scheduled task was removed by the install script because it installed clients successfully<br>    Write-Host "[SUCCESSFUL_AUTOPATCH_CLIENT_SETUP_SCHEDULED]"<br>    Cleanup<br>    Stop-Transcript -Verbose<br>    exit 0<br>}<br><br>if ($MaxRetries -ne 0) {<br>    # There was some error in attempting to install the clients<br>    Write-Error "[FAILED_AUTOPATCH_CLIENT_SETUP_SCHEDULED]" -Category NotInstalled<br>}<br>else {<br>    # We timed out on waiting for the task to complete<br>    Write-Error "[UNKNOWN_AUTOPATCH_CLIENT_SETUP_SCHEDULED]" -Category OperationTimeout<br>}<br><br># Grab results from most recent log file and add them to the transcript<br>$InternalScriptPrefix = 'AutopatchClientV2SetupInstallTask'<br>$LogFound = $false<br>foreach ($InstallLogFile in (Get-ChildItem $LogPath \| Sort-Object LastAccessTime -Descending)) {<br>    if ($InstallLogFile.Name.StartsWith($InternalScriptPrefix) -and $InstallLogFile.Extension.Equals('.log')) {<br>        Write-Error "----------[Start] Results from Install Task ----------"<br>        $FullInstallLogPath = $LogPath + '\' + $InstallLogFile.Name<br>        $LogContents = Get-Content $FullInstallLogPath -Raw<br>        Write-Error $LogContents<br>        Write-Error "----------[End] Results from Install Task ----------"<br>        $LogFound = $true<br>        break<br>    }<br>}<br><br>if (-not $LogFound) {<br>    Write-Error "[Log Not Found]"<br>    Get-ChildItem $LogPath \| ### POC_WIN_D_CO_PS_BitLockerKeyEscrow
Description: Used to capture existing BitLocker recovery keys from devices not encrypted by Microsoft Intune\.
#### Assignments
|intent |      target      |filter type|filter name|
|-------|------------------|-----------|-----------|
|Include|SG_MDM_D_WIN_CO   |none       |           |
|Exclude|SG_MDM_D_WIN_CO_AP|none       |           |
|Exclude|SG_MDM_D_CPC_CO   |none       |           |

#### Configuration
|        setting        |                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                value                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                 |
|-----------------------|--------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------|
|Enforce Signature Check|False |Run As32 Bit           |True |Display Name           |POC_WIN_D_CO_PS_BitLockerKeyEscrow |Script Content         |<details><summary>Click to expand...</summary><#<br>.SYNOPSIS<br>    Escrow (Backup) the existing Bitlocker key protectors to Azure AD (Intune)<br><br>.DESCRIPTION<br>    This script will verify the presence of existing recovery keys and have them escrowed (backed up) to Azure AD<br>    Great for switching away from MBAM on-prem to using Intune and Azure AD for Bitlocker key management<br><br>.INPUTS<br>    None<br><br>.NOTES<br>    Version       : 1.0<br>    Author        : Michael Mardahl<br>    Twitter       : @michael_mardahl<br>    Blogging on   : www.msendpointmgr.com<br>    Creation Date : 11 January 2021<br>    Purpose/Change: Initial script<br>    License       : MIT (Leave author credits)<br><br>.EXAMPLE<br>    Execute script as system or administrator<br>    .\Invoke-EscrowBitlockerToAAD.ps1<br><br>.NOTES<br>    If there is a policy mismatch, then you might get errors from the built-in cmdlet BackupToAAD-BitLockerKeyProtector.<br>    So I have wrapped the cmdlet in a try/catch in order to supress the error. This means that you will have to manually verify that the key was actually escrowed.<br>    Check MSEndpointMgr.com for solutions to get reporting stats on this.<br><br>#><br><br>#region declarations<br><br>$DriveLetter = $env:SystemDrive<br><br>#endregion declarations<br><br>#region functions<br><br>function Test-Bitlocker ($BitlockerDrive) {<br>    #Tests the drive for existing Bitlocker keyprotectors<br>    try {<br>        Get-BitLockerVolume -MountPoint $BitlockerDrive -ErrorAction Stop<br>    }<br>    catch {<br>        Write-Output "Bitlocker was not found protecting the $BitlockerDrive drive. Terminating script!"<br>        exit 0<br>    }<br>}<br><br>function Get-KeyProtectorId ($BitlockerDrive) {<br>    #fetches the key protector ID of the drive<br>    $BitLockerVolume = Get-BitLockerVolume -MountPoint $BitlockerDrive<br>    $KeyProtector = $BitLockerVolume.KeyProtector \| Where-Object { $_.KeyProtectorType -eq 'RecoveryPassword' }<br>    return $KeyProtector.KeyProtectorId<br>}<br><br>function Invoke-BitlockerEscrow ($BitlockerDrive, $BitlockerKey) {<br>    #Escrow the key into Azure AD<br>    try {<br>        BackupToAAD-BitLockerKeyProtector -MountPoint $BitlockerDrive -KeyProtectorId $BitlockerKey -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue<br>        Write-Output 'Attempted to escrow key in Azure AD - Please verify manually!'<br>        exit 0<br>    }<br>    catch {<br>        Write-Error 'This should never have happend? Debug me!'<br>        exit 1<br>    }<br>}<br><br>#endregion functions<br><br>#region execute<br><br>Test-Bitlocker -BitlockerDrive $DriveLetter<br>$KeyProtectorId = Get-KeyProtectorId -BitlockerDrive $DriveLetter<br>Invoke-BitlockerEscrow -BitlockerDrive $DriveLetter -BitlockerKey $KeyProtectorId<br><br>#endregion execute<br><br></details>|
|Run As Account         |system {<br>        Write-Warning -Message "Unable to append log entry to $scriptName file"<br>    }<br>}<br><br>Write-LogEntry -Value "$(Get-Date -Format yyy.MM.dd-hh:mm:ss) - Starting App removal process"<br>foreach ($removeApp in $removeApps) {<br>    $appxPackage = Get-AppxPackage -Name $removeApp -AllUsers -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue<br>    $appxProvisioningPackage = Write-LogEntry -Value "$(Get-Date -Format yyy.MM.dd-hh:mm:ss) - Removed App $($appxPackage.PackageFullName)"<br>        }<br>        catch {<br>            Write-LogEntry -Value "$(Get-Date -Format yyy.MM.dd-hh:mm:ss) - Unable to remove App $($appxPackage.PackageFullName)"<br>        }<br>    }<br>    else {<br>        Write-LogEntry -Value "$(Get-Date -Format yyy.MM.dd-hh:mm:ss) - Could not find AppxPackage $removeApp"<br>    }<br><br>    Write-LogEntry -Value "$(Get-Date -Format yyy.MM.dd-hh:mm:ss) - Finding AppxProvisioningPackage for $removeApp"<br>    if ($appxProvisioningPackage) {<br>        try {<br>            Get-AppxProvisionedPackage -Online \| Where-Object DisplayName -Like $removeApp \| Remove-AppxProvisionedPackage -Online -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue<br> ### POC_WIN_D_CO_PS_SBL_CIS_MS_BitLockerTPMandPIN
Description: Used in conjunction with a BitLocker policy that allows TPM and TPMandPIN key protectors, removes the TPM protector and adds in a TPMandPIN protector with the PIN set to the first 14 characters of the device serial number in uppercase\.
#### Assignments
|intent |           target            |filter type|filter name|
|-------|-----------------------------|-----------|-----------|
|Include|TEST_SG_MDM_D_WIN_CIS_MS_COPE|none       |           |

#### Configuration
|        setting        |                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                    value                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                     |
|-----------------------|----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------|
|Enforce Signature Check|False                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                         |
|Run As32 Bit           |False                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                         |
|Display Name           |POC_WIN_D_CO_PS_SBL_CIS_MS_BitLockerTPMandPIN                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                 |
|Script Content         |<details><summary>Click to expand...</summary>try {<br>    $osVolume = Get-BitLockerVolume \| Where-Object { $_.VolumeType -eq 'OperatingSystem' }<br><br>    # Detects if TPMPin already set<br>    if ($osVolume.KeyProtector.KeyProtectorType -contains 'TpmPin') {<br>        exit 0<br>    }<br><br>    # Sets a recovery password key protector if one doesn't exist, needed for TpmPin key protector<br>    if ($osVolume.KeyProtector.KeyProtectorType -notcontains 'RecoveryPassword') {<br>        Enable-BitLocker -MountPoint $osVolume.MountPoint -RecoveryPasswordProtector<br>    }<br><br>    # Configures the PIN (14 characters of the serial in Upper Case)<br>    $deviceSerial = (((Get-CimInstance -Class win32_bios).SerialNumber).ToUpper() -replace '[^a-zA-Z0-9]', '')<br>    if ($deviceSerial.length -gt 14) {<br>        $deviceSerial = $deviceSerial.Substring(0, 14) # Reduce to 14 characters if longer<br>    }<br><br>    # Enables BitLocker using the TpmPin key protector<br>    $devicePIN = ConvertTo-SecureString $deviceSerial -AsPlainText -Force<br>    Enable-BitLocker -MountPoint $osVolume.MountPoint -Pin $devicePIN -TpmAndPinProtector<br><br>    # Gets the recovery key and escrows to Entra<br>    (Get-BitLockerVolume).KeyProtector \| Where-Object { $_.KeyProtectorType -eq 'RecoveryPassword' } \| ForEach-Object {<br>        BackupToAAD-BitLockerKeyProtector -MountPoint $osVolume.MountPoint -KeyProtectorId $_.KeyProtectorId<br>    }<br>    exit 0<br>}<br>catch {<br>    $ErrorMessage = $_.Exception.Message<br>    Write-Warning $ErrorMessage<br>    exit 1<br>}</details>|
|Run As Account         |system                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        |
|File Name              |Set-BitLockerTPMandPin.ps1                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                    |
|Role Scope Tag Ids     |Default<br/>                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  |

|Script Content         |<details><summary>Click to expand...</summary><##############################################################################<br>   <br>    CIS Microsoft Intune for Windows 11 Benchmark v4.0.0 Build Kit script<br>    Section #81 - System Services<br>    Level 1 (L1)<br><br>    The purpose of this script is to configure a system using the recommendations <br>    provided in the Benchmark, section(s), and profile level listed above to a <br>    hardened state consistent with a CIS Benchmark. <br>    <br>    The script can be tailored to the organization's needs such as by creating <br>    exceptions or adding additional event logging.<br><br>    This script can be deployed through various means, including Intune script <br>    manager, running it locally, or through any automation tool.<br><br>    Version: 1.10<br>    Updated: 24.Apr.2025 by jjarose<br><br>##############################################################################><br><br>#Requires -RunAsAdministrator<br><br>$L1Services = @{<br>    'Computer Browser'                             = 'HKLM:\SYSTEM\CurrentControlSet\Services\Browser'<br>    'IIS Admin Service'                            = 'HKLM:\SYSTEM\CurrentControlSet\Services\IISADMIN'<br>    'Infrared monitor service'                     = 'HKLM:\SYSTEM\CurrentControlSet\Services\irmon'<br>    'LxssManager'                                  = 'HKLM:\SYSTEM\CurrentControlSet\Services\LxssManager'<br>    'Microsoft FTP Service'                        = 'HKLM:\SYSTEM\CurrentControlSet\Services\FTPSVC'<br>    'OpenSSH SSH Server'                           = 'HKLM:\SYSTEM\CurrentControlSet\Services\sshd'<br>    'Remote Procedure Call (RPC) Locator'          = 'HKLM:\SYSTEM\CurrentControlSet\Services\RpcLocator'<br>    'Routing and Remote Access'                    = 'HKLM:\SYSTEM\CurrentControlSet\Services\RemoteAccess'<br>    'Simple TCP/IP LocalServices'                  = 'HKLM:\SYSTEM\CurrentControlSet\Services\simptcp'<br>    'Special Administration Console Helper'        = 'HKLM:\SYSTEM\CurrentControlSet\Services\sacsvr'<br>    'SSDP Discovery'                               = 'HKLM:\SYSTEM\CurrentControlSet\Services\SSDPSRV'<br>    'UPnP Device Host'                             = 'HKLM:\SYSTEM\CurrentControlSet\Services\upnphost'<br>    'Web Management Service'                       = 'HKLM:\SYSTEM\CurrentControlSet\Services\WMSvc'<br>    'Windows Media Player Network Sharing Service' = 'HKLM:\SYSTEM\CurrentControlSet\Services\WMPNetworkSvc'<br>    'Windows Mobile Hotspot Service'               = 'HKLM:\SYSTEM\CurrentControlSet\Services\icssvc'<br>    'World Wide Web Publishing Service'            = 'HKLM:\SYSTEM\CurrentControlSet\Services\W3SVC'<br>    'Xbox Accessory Management Service'            = 'HKLM:\SYSTEM\CurrentControlSet\Services\XboxGipSvc'<br>    'Xbox Live Auth Manager'                       = 'HKLM:\SYSTEM\CurrentControlSet\Services\XblAuthManager'<br>    'Xbox Live Game Save'                          = 'HKLM:\SYSTEM\CurrentControlSet\Services\XblGameSave'<br>    'Xbox Live Networking Service'                 = 'HKLM:\SYSTEM\CurrentControlSet\Services\XboxNetApiSvc'<br>}<br><br>$DisabledCount = 0<br>$AlreadyDisabledCount = 0<br>$NotInstalledCount = 0<br><br>foreach ($service in $L1Services.GetEnumerator()) {<br>    $ServiceName = $service.Key<br>    $ServicePath = $service.Value<br><br>    if (Test-Path -LiteralPath $ServicePath) {<br>        $StartValue = (Get-ItemProperty -LiteralPath $ServicePath).Start<br><br>        if ($StartValue -and $StartValue -ne 4) {<br>            Set-ItemProperty -LiteralPath $ServicePath -Name 'Start' -Value 4<br>            Write-Host "Disabled service $ServiceName." -ForegroundColor Yellow<br>            $DisabledCount++<br>        } elseif ($StartValue -eq 4) {<br>            Write-Host "Service $ServiceName is already disabled." -ForegroundColor Green<br>            $AlreadyDisabledCount++<br>        }<br>    } else {<br>        Write-Host "Service $ServiceName is not installed." -ForegroundColor Green<br>        $NotInstalledCount++<br>    }<br>}<br><br>Write-Host "`nThis script configured $DisabledCount services as 'Disabled'." -ForegroundColor Cyan<br>Write-Host "$AlreadyDisabledCount services were already disabled and $NotInstalledCount are not installed." -ForegroundColor Green</details>|

|Script Content         |<details><summary>Click to expand...</summary>function Cleanup {<br>    cd $PSScriptRoot<br>    if (Test-Path $ScriptFolderPath) {<br>        Write-Host 'Removing script directory'<br>        Remove-Item -LiteralPath $ScriptFolderPath -Force -Recurse<br>    }<br>}<br><br>Function Setup {<br>    # Cleanup scheduled task if it exists<br>    $oldTask = Get-ScheduledTask -TaskName $ScheduledTaskName -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue<br>    if ($oldTask) {<br>        if ($oldTask.State -eq 'Running') {<br>            Stop-ScheduledTask -TaskName $ScheduledTaskName<br>        }<br>        Unregister-ScheduledTask -TaskName $ScheduledTaskName -Confirm:$false -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue<br>    }<br>    Cleanup<br>}<br><br>$LogPrefix = "\AutopatchClientV2SetupInstallScheduled"<br>$Timestamp = Get-Date<br>$LogPath = "$Env:windir\ccm\logs"<br>$LogFile = $LogPath + $LogPrefix + $Timestamp.ToFileTimeUtc() + ".log"<br>$ScheduledTaskName = 'Autopatch Client V2 Setup Installer'<br>$ScriptFolderPath = "$env:SystemDrive\ProgramData\Microsoft\AutopatchSetupScheduled"<br>$SystemScriptPath = "$ScriptFolderPath\SetupAutopatchClientV2Package.ps1"<br>$SystemScript = ''<br><br>if (-not (Test-Path $LogPath)) {<br>    New-Item -Force -ItemType directory -Path $LogPath<br>}<br>Start-Transcript -Path $LogFile<br><br>#Cleanup lingering resources from previous runs<br>Setup<br><br>$content = [System.Convert]::FromBase64String($SystemScript)<br><br>New-Item -ItemType Directory -Force -Path $ScriptFolderPath<br>Set-Content -Path $SystemScriptPath -Value $content -Encoding Byte<br><br>$Trigger = New-ScheduledTaskTrigger -Once -At ((Get-Date).AddHours(4)) -RepetitionInterval (New-TimeSpan -Hours 4) # Specify the trigger settings<br>$Settings = New-ScheduledTaskSettingsSet -AllowStartIfOnBatteries<br>$User = "NT AUTHORITY\SYSTEM"<br>$Argument = "-ExecutionPolicy Bypass $SystemScriptPath"<br>$Action = New-ScheduledTaskAction -Execute "PowerShell.exe" -Argument $argument # Specify what program to run andtask with its parameters<br>Register-ScheduledTask -TaskName $ScheduledTaskName -Trigger $Trigger -User $User -Action $Action -Settings $Settings -RunLevel Highest -Force<br><br>$MaxRetries = 10<br>Start-ScheduledTask -TaskName $ScheduledTaskName<br>$ScheduledTask = Get-ScheduledTask -TaskName $ScheduledTaskName -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue<br><br># Wait for the scheduled task to complete so its log can be read and uploaded<br>while (-not (($ScheduledTask.State -eq 'Ready') -or ($MaxRetries -eq 0))) {<br>    Write-Host "Waiting for scheduled task to complete"<br>    Start-Sleep -Seconds 60<br>    $MaxRetries--<br>    $ScheduledTask = Get-ScheduledTask -TaskName $ScheduledTaskName -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue<br>    if (-not $ScheduledTask) {<br>        # The scheduled task was removed by the install script because it installed clients successfully<br>        break<br>    }<br>}<br><br>if (-not $ScheduledTask) {<br>    # The scheduled task was removed by the install script because it installed clients successfully<br>    Write-Host "[SUCCESSFUL_AUTOPATCH_CLIENT_SETUP_SCHEDULED]"<br>    Cleanup<br>    Stop-Transcript -Verbose<br>    exit 0<br>}<br><br>if ($MaxRetries -ne 0) {<br>    # There was some error in attempting to install the clients<br>    Write-Error "[FAILED_AUTOPATCH_CLIENT_SETUP_SCHEDULED]" -Category NotInstalled<br>}<br>else {<br>    # We timed out on waiting for the task to complete<br>    Write-Error "[UNKNOWN_AUTOPATCH_CLIENT_SETUP_SCHEDULED]" -Category OperationTimeout<br>}<br><br># Grab results from most recent log file and add them to the transcript<br>$InternalScriptPrefix = 'AutopatchClientV2SetupInstallTask'<br>$LogFound = $false<br>foreach ($InstallLogFile in (Get-ChildItem $LogPath \| Sort-Object LastAccessTime -Descending)) {<br>    if ($InstallLogFile.Name.StartsWith($InternalScriptPrefix) -and $InstallLogFile.Extension.Equals('.log')) {<br>        Write-Error "----------[Start] Results from Install Task ----------"<br>        $FullInstallLogPath = $LogPath + '\' + $InstallLogFile.Name<br>        $LogContents = Get-Content $FullInstallLogPath -Raw<br>        Write-Error $LogContents<br>        Write-Error "----------[End] Results from Install Task ----------"<br>        $LogFound = $true<br>        break<br>    }<br>}<br><br>if (-not $LogFound) {<br>    Write-Error "[Log Not Found]"<br>    Get-ChildItem $LogPath \| ### REF_WIN_D_CO_PS_WindowsEnterpriseActivation
Description: Resolved issues with Subscription Activation\.
#### Configuration
|        setting        |                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                            value                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                            |
|-----------------------|-----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------|
|Enforce Signature Check|False                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        |
|Run As32 Bit           |False                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        |
|Display Name           |REF_WIN_D_CO_PS_WindowsEnterpriseActivation                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  |
|Script Content         |<details><summary>Click to expand...</summary># Define the registry key path and value<br>$registryPath = 'HKLM:\SOFTWARE\Microsoft\Windows NT\CurrentVersion\MfaRequiredInClipRenew'<br>$registryValueName = 'Verify Multifactor Authentication in ClipRenew'<br>$registryValueData = 0  # DWORD value of 0<br>$sid = New-Object System.Security.Principal.SecurityIdentifier('S-1-5-4')<br># or SID S-1-5-4 for the interactive group<br><br># Check if the registry key already exists<br>if (-not (Test-Path -Path $registryPath)) {<br>    # If the key doesn't exist, create it and set the DWORD value<br>    New-Item -Path $registryPath -Force \| Out-Null<br>    Set-ItemProperty -Path $registryPath -Name $registryValueName -Value $registryValueData -Type DWORD<br>    Write-Output 'Registry key created and DWORD value added.'<br>}<br>else {<br>    Write-Output 'Registry key already exists. No changes made.'<br>}<br><br># Add read permissions for SID (S-1-5-4,interactive users) to the registry key with inheritance<br>$acl = Get-Acl -Path $registryPath<br>$ruleSID = New-Object System.Security.AccessControl.RegistryAccessRule($sid, 'FullControl', 'ContainerInherit,ObjectInherit', 'None', 'Allow')<br>$acl.AddAccessRule($ruleSID)<br>Set-Acl -Path $registryPath -AclObject $acl<br>Write-Output "Added 'Interactive' group and SID ($sid) with read permissions (with inheritance) to the registry key."<br><br>#Start the scheduledtask<br>Get-ScheduledTask -TaskName 'LicenseAcquisition' \| Start-ScheduledTask<br>Start-Process "$env:SystemRoot\system32\ClipRenew.exe"</details>|
|Run As Account         |system                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                       |
|File Name              |Start-EntActivation.ps1                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      |
|Role Scope Tag Ids     |Default<br/>                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                 |
